metadata.llm_reason: D3 Transform Manipulation is a distinct micro-skill focused on 2D affine transform operations (scale, translate, invert, rescale) for coordinate system conversions. It does not overlap with peer candidates: Path Command Execution (path drawing primitives), Array Transform Operations (array restructuring), or Locale-Specific Time Formatter Creation (time formatting). The skill is well-defined, supported by D3 API documentation, has no conflicts, and addresses a specific coordinate transformation need in the transform_execution stage.
